    AI Overview
    Rocky Carroll did not choose to leave NCIS but was written off as Director Leon Vance in the 500th episode (March 2026) as a creative decision by producers to create a shocking, high-impact moment after 18 seasons. Producers aimed for a dramatic, "full circle" death for the character, though Carroll continues as a director for the show. 
    Key Details Behind the Exit: 
    • Creative Decision: The decision was made by producers to deliver a "spectacular" shocker for the 500th episode, not because Carroll wanted to leave, says this article on Us Weekly.
    • A Planned Ending: According to this MARCA article, producers had considered killing off Vance for over a decade but only moved forward with it in Season 23, believing it was the right time for a high-magnitude storyline, says this MARCA article.
    • Not a Total Departure: Carroll, who directed multiple episodes, continues to work with NCIS behind the camera, says this Parade article.
    • Character Arc: The 500th episode was designed as a "love letter" to Vance, with his death scene shot on December 11, 2025, according to this E! News article. 
    Note: Based on results published in March 2026.

    Did Mark Harmon and Rocky Carroll get along?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Mark Harmon and Rocky Carroll are close friends and long-time collaborators. Their friendship dates back to the 1990s when they both starred in "Chicago Hope," and they maintained a strong personal and professional relationship on the set of NCIS. Carroll has described Harmon as a major supporter who helped secure his role on NCIS. 
    • Long-Term Connection: The actors met while working together on the CBS drama "Chicago Hope" during the 1990s.
    • Recommendation for NCIS: Carroll noted that he was hired for the role of Leon Vance in NCIS partly because Harmon, who knew him well, suggested they hire him.
    • Professional Mutual Support:
      Carroll has referred to Harmon as a "supporter" and described their working relationship as a "fun" collaboration.
    • Solidified Friendship: Beyond the screen, they maintained a positive and friendly relationship behind the scenes of the show for many years.
